description: Source PHP class implementing a REST API endpoint for managing 'License' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes CRUD operations, validation, and linkage to service and model layers.

classes.name: LicenseAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint for managing License entities, supporting CRUD operations with validation and integration with service and model layers.

methods.name: getLicenseService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LicenseService object used for business logic related to licenses.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single License object by its ID, returns it wrapped in a resource result for API output.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, primarily validating the ID parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of licenses based on search filters, sorting, and pagination, returning a collection result with metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing licenses, such as sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new License entity based on request data and saves it via the service layer, returning the created resource.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Sets the name of the License object from request data and persists it using the license service.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a license, mainly ensuring the 'name' field is provided and valid.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing License identified by ID, saving changes via the service layer, and returning the updated resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating licenses, including unique name validation ignoring the current entity.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Helper to generate validation rule for the 'name' parameter, including string, length, and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple licenses based on provided IDs, returns confirmation via list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, mainly verifying presence of IDs.
